block.description:
Resource to get a SCEPman issued certificate from a CSR.

## Authorization Requirements
To be able to use this resource, the calling service principal must have the following application permissions:
- CSR.Request on the SCEPman API application in the target tenant.

common_name.description: Common name of the certificate. Changing requires replacement.

expires_at.description: Timestamp of the expiration of the certificate.

id.description: The ID of the TLS Inspection certificate graph resource.

last_updated.description: Timestamp of the last update of the certificate.

name.description: Name of the certificate. Autogenerated, because it needs to be unique on every certificate and would otherwise prevent rotation.

organization_name.description: Organization name of the certificate. Changing requires replacement.

renew_before.description: Number of days before the certificate expires that the provider should renew it.

status.description: Status of the certificate as reported by Microsoft Graph.

block.description:
Resource to manage a Entra GSA TLS Inspection certificate together with SCEPman.
It creates a externalCertificateAuthorityCertificate resource in Microsoft Graph, then signs it with SCEPman and updates the certificate resource with the generated certificate.
For day two operations, it will replace the certificate if it is going to expire in less than the configured renew_before threshold.

## Authorization Requirements
To be able to use this resource, the calling service principal must have the following application permissions:
- CSR.Request on the SCEPman API application in the target tenant.
- NetworkAccess.ReadWrite.All on the Microsoft Graph API application in the target tenant.
